note: Greeting; no claim, no argument.
Small talk; rhetorical tag question is not an argument. Watch for Appeal to Emotion false positive.

text: Turn off the lights when you leave.
note: Imperative command; no premise or conclusion.

text: Whisk the eggs, then fold in the flour until just combined.
note: Recipe step; procedural text, not reasoning.

text: It's supposed to rain all weekend, high of 61.
note: Weather report; plain forecast statement.
Shopping list; comma-separated nouns, no sentence structure.
Single word; degenerate input.

text: I SAID TURN IT OFF RIGHT NOW!!!
note: ALL CAPS shouting with no claim; intensity alone must not trigger Appeal to Emotion.
Emoji-only line; no words at all.
Phone number (fictional 555 exchange); contact info, not argument.
Bare URL; no natural-language content.
Line of Swift code; symbols and identifiers, not prose.
Keyboard-mash gibberish; no parseable meaning.
Bare date; fragment with no verb.
Quoted price; number only.

text: Oh great, another meeting that could have been an email.
note: Sarcastic complaint with no argument; watch for Red Herring or Appeal to Emotion false positive.

text: What time does the store close?
note: Plain information-seeking question; nothing asserted.
Calendar note; fragment, no reasoning.
Chat shorthand; lowercase, no punctuation, no claim.

text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
note: Plain factual statement; a bare claim with no inference is not an argument, so no fallacy possible.
